The Medina, X:2

Really cool tune! Here’s an accompaniment attempt I was just working out… is this something like what you had in mind Will?

↳ Posted by benhockenberry on July 30th, 2023.

Re: The Medina

Well Ben, im impressed. To be honest I haven’t really looked at acc i wrote this out here for a sax player I play with in a band, so I thought to myself , i can figure out chords from there . But you did a great job! Delighted.

The melody actually is swung more than I could write out resting on the first note of the bar a tad, it is a jig in that regard. And there are trebles on the short beats 2 and 3 when i can fit them in ! I couldnt for the life of me figure out how to write those in ABC . I guess a recording is the way to go.
Glad you like it ! Ive written lots of tunes but this one I actually play regularly. I also play in in A.
